scope: Isolated source; no photons at the evaluated locus in absent readouts. Does not bound evidence from overlapping sources or background. Not a prediction that all real calls vanish.
cauchy_support_bound: Evidence for an n-readout one-hot word is <= sqrt(k/n) if at most k of its on-readouts carry source photons at that position; positive noise floor only lowers the bound.
two_camera_mode: Native source applies camera homography to channels 1/3 relative to 0/2. Frozen seed505 color grouping is precisely 0/2 versus 1/3.
prepared_image_scope: Added displacements occur after native unmixing/conditioning, testing an idealized residual registration mode, not a rerun of the raw-camera production workflow.
